correctness.rationale: Witt extension over an infinite ambient nondegenerate alternating space classifies tuple orbits by quotient kernel H, the map H to the base U, and pairings with U. All new pairings are set to zero. Surjection enumeration gives the general sum; radical intersection and symplectic isotropic frame counting yield the J_t Gaussian product. Direct dimension-of-quotient 0/1/2 counting gives the pair formula and a strictly positive coefficient q^d-q^(d-1) of q^rho. Independent finite ambient signature enumeration and finite-map stratum enumeration confirm the formulas on all indicated cases; neither finite test is asserted to prove the infinite theorem.

value.rationale: The natural definable zero-pairing condition produces a sharply distinguishing numerical invariant for finite named subspace geometries: T1 fixes dimension but never radical, while T2 recovers radical for every q. An exact all-arity spectrum and sharp unary counterexample identify a finite-arithmetic signature of the finite-base symplectic isometry class; this is more than recomputing an unmarked Gaussian coefficient.
